To prepare a corpus for a reliable NovaLearn deployment, the customer should complete the corpus audit/cataloging phase (Phase 2), working closely with content owners:

- **Document source audit**: Identify where knowledge is stored (SharePoint, Google Drive, local servers, Confluence) and catalog file formats and volumes [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **Format inspection**: Confirm all documents are in supported formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, XLSX); flag legacy or unsupported formats for conversion [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **OCR identification**: Scan the corpus for image-only or scanned PDFs lacking native text layers and flag them for OCR; explain that OCR is required for reliable citations and may extend the onboarding timeline [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **Document taxonomy definition**: Design the KnowledgeHub tagging system and custom metadata schemas (e.g., department, product, region) to enable precise filtering and retrieval [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **Verify the corpus audit checklist** before delivering the Corpus Inventory Sheet: file names descriptive with no special symbols; no duplicate policy manuals; scanned files separated and marked "OCR Required: True"; every document assigned a department and owner; source files have clear H1/H2/H3 heading structures [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **Broader onboarding prep**: Audit the knowledge base, clean up stale documentation, structure permission groups, and run a controlled pilot before broader launch [NL-005#NL-005-S01].
- **Scanned-document cleanup**: Perform a document cleanup phase prior to ingestion and identify/clean up scanned documents during the pilot to support high citation accuracy [NL-009#NL-009-S05].
